verdict.rationale: The built-in `@plugin-creator`/`plugin-creator` skill explicitly guides authoring (asks what the skill does, when it triggers, scripts vs instruction-only), scaffolds the required `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` manifest, wires MCP, and generates a local marketplace entry for testing — covering writing, improving, and packaging. This was independently confirmed via a real runtime install (`npx skills add openai/plugins --skill plugin-creator`) proving it's a portable, installable meta-skill. missing for 10: no independent hands-on evidence of the 'improving' step (iterating on an existing skill) beyond creation/packaging, and no third-party review specifically praising the creator's guidance quality.
